reason: Record remediation and focused proof for every second-review finding.

operation.summary: Closed the exact-ID detail, browser cursor authentication, and population-policy allocation defects.
changes: Detail lookup now resolves the exact policy-visible ID directly, including 65-128 byte IDs and labels or roles that contain another agent ID.
Every exact-successor browser update returns the prior cursor to Runtime and accepts the snapshot only when Runtime validates the cursor and returns the matching new cursor.
Serialized page results no longer clone the Runtime-owned population visibility policy.
